It can deflect a Guardian Scout's beam.|Inventory|BotW}} Guardian Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 18 |durability = 10 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = Yes |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Guardian Shield}} Guardian Shields are [[Shield]]s wielded by [[Guardian Scout II|Guardian Scouts II]] within "A Minor Test of Strength" [[Ancient Shrine]]s. They also have a chance to appear in [[Treasure Chest]]s that spawn when the {{BotW}} Series [[Guardian]] [[amiibo]] is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. They were made with the [[Ancient Technology]] of the [[Sheikah]]. They have the special ability to deflect the beams of [[Guardian Scout]]s. Guardian Shields belong to the [[Guardian Gear]] equipment archetype.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 175}} As they are made with Ancient Technology, Guardian Shields will float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. In addition, they will not burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], and they will not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s. They also cannot be manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_013" |Life = 10 |GuardPower = 18 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 2 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 3 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 3 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 11 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 1 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Guardian Shields can be wielded by [[Link]] in conjunction with [[Guardian Sword]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Ancient Technology * Guardian Gear * Guardian Shield+ * Guardian Shield++ * Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Ancient Technology, Guardian Gear, Shields |items= BotW, AoC }}
